0022600090.text: Both the Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, so neither team has a record yet. The teams split their two meetings in 2025-26, and the most recent one was a 127-119 Pacers win in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026. The Pacers are without Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Jarace Walker (undisclosed) and T.J. McConnell (undisclosed) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while the Pelicans have no listed absences.
